Our services

Physical and occupational therapy, hand therapy, pediatric rehabilitation, sports medicine and more, at both offices.

See all services

What we treat

From a sore back to a full recovery after surgery.

Our physical and occupational therapists treat the conditions that keep people from moving, working and playing the way they want to.

Schedule an evaluation
  • Back and neck pain
  • Post-operative rehabilitation
  • Fractures
  • Arthritis
  • Sports injuries
  • Dislocations and joint injuries
  • Muscle and tendon injuries
  • Hand, wrist and elbow injuries
  • Headaches and TMJ dysfunction
  • Injury, accident and trauma
  • Amputations
  • Pediatric developmental delays

Insurance

We accept most major plans

Medicare certified at both locations. If you don't see your plan, call us and we'll check your coverage before your first visit.

We also accept Priority Health, Cofinity, Children's Special Health Care Services, auto insurance and workers' compensation claims.

Self-pay and payment plans available.

Ready when you are

Schedule online any time, or call either office during business hours and we'll find a time that works for you.
